pages.title: A captured essence
pages.text: “Even after death, the soul does not lose its connection to the world. Everything that once belonged to it still feels its call.”$(br2)The Soul’s pull draws objects and realms of experience that happen to be nearby toward the one who bears it.

pages.title: Gravity
pages.text: Attraction automatically draws in all objects and experiences within a radius of $(thing)16 blocks$(). Simply equip the artifact as boots or place it in a Vault cell.
